title: 第10章 目标赚钱，月入两万
slug: 狗哥你再舔女主我就和黄毛私奔
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

秦渡：……

好有道理。

一时之间竟无法反驳。

看着沉默的秦渡，赵楹月也知道不能把人逼得太紧。

于是给了一颗甜枣，“宝宝你放心，只要你不找别的女人，我肯定会爱你一辈子！”

赵楹月主动加上了秦渡的好友。

在备注那栏果断敲下几个大字:【超级无敌亲亲老公酱】。

秦渡：……

他欲言又止。

藏在短碎发下的耳尖，不自然的染上了一层薄红。

中午，赵楹月做东，从酒楼点了一大桌好菜。

李刚和宁南吃的狼吞虎咽，好吃到快要落泪：“老大，我们将永远追随你！”

与之相比，秦渡就显得要斯文优雅许多。

即便是失忆了，他那从骨子里透出的礼节和教养，都彰显出他的不凡。

饭后，宁南悄悄找上赵楹月。

小声说：“老大，我觉得……秦三不像是什么普通人。”

赵楹月直接敲了他一个爆栗。

“不是普通人是什么？”赵楹月瞪他，“如果他身份显赫，我们早在网上看到悬赏消息了，这都快一个星期了吧？什么都没有。”

“好像是诶！”宁南恍然大悟。

旋即，又皱眉忧愁，“可是他很优雅啊。”

迎接宁南的，又是一个爆栗。

赵楹月振振有词，“我说你笨你是真笨，就不能是秦三爱装吗？”

毕竟她就挺喜欢装的。

没装过逼的人，永远不知道有多爽。

宁南诡异的被说服了。

而正在前台辛苦工作的秦渡，毫无征兆的打了个喷嚏。

目光下意识看向休息室的方向。

一定是赵楹月在说他坏话！

耳边是排队人群的小声惊呼：“啊啊！果然帅哥连打个喷嚏都是帅的！”

秦渡：“……”

等他有钱了，他一定换了这份工作！

赵楹月一个下午都窝在休息室。

游戏打累了，困了，就躺在单人床上小睡。

一直到傍晚，才准备离开。

这个点，网吧仍是座无虚席，到处是敲键盘和打游戏开麦的声音。

秦渡累得已经不想说话了。

人往椅子上一坐，脊背松懈，没骨头似的瘫在那。

懒懒的掀眼：“明天你还来吗？”

“如果有时间的话我就来。”

Page (1/3)

Qin Du:......

That makes sense.

It was impossible to refute for a moment.

Looking at the silent Qin Du, Zhao Yingyue also knew not to push the person too hard.

So he gave me a sweet date, "Don't worry, baby, as long as you don't find another woman, I will definitely love you forever!"

Zhao Yingyue took the initiative to become Qin Du's friend.

Decisively type a few big words in the remarks column: [Super Invincible Kiss Husband Sauce].

Qin Du:......

He hesitated to speak.

The tips of the ears hidden under the short broken hair were unnaturally stained with a thin layer of red.

At noon, Zhao Yingyue served as host and ordered a large table of delicious dishes from the restaurant.

Li Gang and Ning Nan devoured the food so deliciously that they almost cried: "Boss, we will always follow you!"

In comparison, Qin Du seemed much more gentle and elegant.

Even though he has lost his memory, his etiquette and upbringing from the bottom of his heart show that he is extraordinary.

After dinner, Ning Nan quietly approached Zhao Yingyue.

He whispered: "Boss, I don't think...Qin San is like an ordinary person."

Zhao Yingyue gave him a quick blow.

"What is he if he's not an ordinary person?" Zhao Yingyue glared at him, "If he had a prominent identity, we would have seen the reward information on the Internet. It has been almost a week, right? There is nothing."

"It seems so!" Ning Nan suddenly realized.

Immediately, he frowned and said sadly, "But he is very elegant."

What greeted Ning Nan was another burst of chestnuts.

Zhao Yingyue said plausibly, "I said you were stupid, but you are really stupid. Couldn't it be that Qin San loves to pretend?"

After all, she really likes to pretend.

People who have never pretended to be cool will never know how cool it is.

Ning Nan was strangely convinced.

Qin Du, who was working hard at the front desk, sneezed without warning.

His eyes subconsciously looked in the direction of the lounge.

It must be Zhao Yingyue who is talking bad about him!

In my ears, people in the queue exclaimed in low voices: "Ah! Sure enough, the handsome guy is handsome even when he sneezes!"

Qin Du: "..."

When he gets rich, he will definitely change his job!

Zhao Yingyue stayed in the lounge all afternoon.

When I was tired and sleepy from playing games, I lay down on the single bed and took a nap.

It wasn't until evening that I prepared to leave.

At this point, the Internet cafe is still packed, and there are sounds of typing on keyboards and turning on the microphone while playing games.

Qin Du was so tired that he no longer wanted to speak.

The man sat down on the chair, his back relaxed, and he lay there as if he had no bones.

He lazily raised his eyes and said, "Are you coming tomorrow?"

"I'll come if I have time."
